svg.title: 2. Workforce access with Verified Access
svg.text: Group: back-office (policy applies to every endpoint in it)
Core VPC 10.48.0.0/18 (no IGW, no public subnets)
Workforce access without a VPN: AWS Verified Access checks who you are and what device you are on, on every request
Each request is evaluated again, so a posture change
mid-session ends access on the next request.
Verified Access endpoint ENIs live in these private
subnets. Nothing here has a route to the internet.
